P1.learning: Both broad total-over-1.5 legs hit, but Puebla-to-score failed. This adds another failure to the weak-team team-to-score residual and strengthens the need to audit whether model/proxy is too optimistic when a low-output underdog only needs one goal.

P2.learning: The goal-floor selections hit, while Guadalajara 1X failed. This is evidence against a blanket penalty on team-to-score markets and instead points to fixture-specific disagreement: the model gave Guadalajara/home-draw materially more protection than the market while Cruz Azul's stronger pre-match form was a warning signal.

P3.learning: P3 was negative EV before kickoff and lost despite two of three legs hitting. Forced inclusion again demonstrates how a single weak leg destroys a parlay; however the EV-disciplined control also lost on J13 because P1 and P2 failed, so two prior jornadas were not enough to validate the control.

learning: J13 again produced 6/9 leg accuracy but 0/3 parlays, illustrating that leg hit rate alone can look acceptable while parlay economics deteriorate sharply because one miss kills the entire ticket.
Positive proxy EV did not protect P1 or P2 from losing. Do not promote proxy EV as validated edge; exact-market audit remains required.

Weak-team team-to-score misses now include Puebla vs Juarez and Queretaro vs Necaxa in J13, joining prior concerns from J12. Investigate whether the model or 1X2-to-Poisson proxy is too generous to low-output underdogs scoring at least once.

Atletico San Luis, Pachuca and Tijuana team-to-score selections all hit, so the signal is not a universal team-goal failure. Segment future residuals by team strength, market-implied underdog severity, home/away status and attacking process rather than applying a blanket market penalty.

Guadalajara 1X failed despite a sizable model-market disagreement. Before any model change, inspect whether recent form, managerial state and opponent strength systematically explain large 1X/ X2 disagreement residuals.
No V0.1R retune or selector change is authorized from J13 alone. Accumulate cross-jornada evidence first.
